description: Price one PLANNED episode (12-60 seconds, 3-8 shots) of a series with a confirmed season plan, starring the character the plan names. FREE: it spends nothing and starts nothing. Returns the shot plan (narration, action, camera and seconds of every shot), the exact credits (up to 313 credits for a default 12-second episode; longer ones (up to 60 seconds) cost more: an AI clip per shot, a still per shot and the narration), and a ready-made nextAction for create_character_episode. Show the human the price and the shots, and call the create tool only after they say yes. The same safety checks as the real call run here: real or famous people, anyone who looks under 18, sexual content and protected characters are refused with CONTENT_POLICY. Only an episode of a REVIEWED, CONFIRMED season plan can be quoted or made: send its script or shots exactly as planned (get_season_plan). Without a confirmed plan the answer is SEASON_PLAN_REQUIRED or SEASON_NOT_REVIEWED, and for shots that are not a planned episode EPISODE_NOT_IN_PLAN, each with a nextAction. The narrator voice, the language, the style and the character come from the plan and cannot be overridden (SEASON_FIELD_LOCKED); to change an episode, edit the plan (that clears the review). Requires the "video:read" scope.

language.description: Omit it: the narration language is the season plan's. If given it must equal the plan's.

script.description: The narration, about 29-147 words. The system splits it into shots by sentence. Give `script` OR `shots`, exactly as planned (get_season_plan).

seriesId.description: A series id from list_series whose season plan is reviewed and confirmed.

sheetId.description: Omit it: the character sheet is the one the season plan names for this episode. If given it must equal that sheet.

shotCount.description: With `script`: how many shots to split it into. Omit for an automatic count.

shots.description: The shots of the planned episode. Give `shots` OR `script`.

action.description: What the viewer sees the character doing. Omit to illustrate the narration.

camera.description: Camera: wide shot, close-up, push-in, over-the-shoulder... Omit for an automatic choice.

narration.description: What the narrator says over this shot.

name: quote_character_episode
title: Quote a character episode
